description: This file defines the ParamsMiddleware class responsible for processing and validating request parameters within a middleware chain, handling user authentication, and error processing for API requests in a Slim PHP framework application.

classes.name: ParamsMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that processes request parameters, manages user authentication, and handles exceptions in an API request cycle.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ParamsMiddleware with parameter handler and bean manager instances.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main middleware method that processes the incoming request, sets current user, and configures parameters.

methods.name: setCurrentUserGlobal
methods.description: Retrieves and sets the current user in global scope based on OAuth2 token from the request.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Extracts route, query, and body parameters from the request and merges them into a single array.
